# n3wth/kit

AI-native component registry for React, built on shadcn's registry protocol.

## Registry

49 items: 1 design system style, 1 utility, 32 UI components, 4 blocks, 11 hooks.

**Registry URL:** https://kit.n3wth.com/r/registry.json

**Install any component:**
```
npx shadcn add https://kit.n3wth.com/r/[name].json
```

Example:
```
npx shadcn add https://kit.n3wth.com/r/button.json
```

## Components

### UI Components
accordion, animated-text, avatar, badge, button, card, character, code-block, command-box, composite-shape, dropdown, error-boundary, hamburger-icon, icon, input, label, mobile-drawer, modal, nav-link, noise-overlay, progress, scroll-indicator, separator, shape, skeleton, speech-bubble, switch, tabs, textarea, theme-toggle, toast, tooltip

### Blocks
footer, hero, nav, section

### Hooks
use-button-pulse, use-count-up, use-keyboard-shortcuts, use-media-query, use-page-transition, use-reduced-motion, use-scroll-reveal, use-stagger-list, use-text-reveal, use-theme, use-toast

### Utilities
cn (Tailwind class merge)

## Design System

Flat, minimal, iOS-inspired. No shadows or gradients unless specified. Ships with light and dark themes via CSS custom properties.

## AI Context Packs

Structured context files for AI coding assistants are available at:
- https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/cursorrules - Cursor AI instructions
- https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/AGENTS.md - AI coding tool API reference
- https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/components.json - Structured JSON for programmatic use
- https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/mcp.json - MCP server config

## Note

This is an independent registry. PR shadcn-ui/ui#11723 to add @n3wth to the official shadcn index is still open.
